backup.title: Backup
backup.description: An .rts file contains all data. Importing it on another device merges the data — nothing is overwritten, so the same file can be imported many times.
backup.importTitle: Merge the backup with the data on this device?
backup.importSummary: Backup from {date}: people {people}, advancements {advancements}, tasks {tasks}. After merging this device will have: people {afterPeople}, advancements {afterAdvancements}, tasks {afterTasks}.
backup.imported: The backup was merged with the data on this device.
backup.neverExported: No backup has been made on this device yet.

backup.reminderMessage: Your data lives only on your devices. A backup lets you recover it if something happens to them.
backup.beforeJoin: Backup of the data from before joining the room ({date})

sync.title: Sync
sync.intro: Connect your own devices or the devices of a mentor and mentee. Changes made at the same time on several devices are merged, nothing is overwritten.
sync.privacy: Data is encrypted with the key stored in the link and flows directly between devices. The server only helps devices find each other and stores nothing.
sync.bothOnline: Sync works while at least two devices have the app open at the same time. When that is not possible, use a backup file (.rts).

state.unsupported: Sync needs HTTPS and a recent browser
state.synced: Synced with {n} device | Synced with {n} devices

sync.invalidLink: This is not a valid sync room link.
sync.linkHint: Anyone with this link can read and change all data. Only send it to people you trust.
sync.qrHint: Scan it with the camera of the other device.
sync.deviceNameHint: Visible to other devices in the room, e.g. “Kuba's phone”.
sync.leaveConfirm: This device will stop syncing. The data stays here and other devices keep their copies.
sync.rotateConfirm: A new room with a new key will be created. Devices with the old link will stop syncing — send the new link only to devices that should stay.
sync.mergeMessage: You can merge it with the room's data or start from the room's data. In the second case the current data is kept as a backup you can download in Settings.
sync.alreadyInRoom: This device is already in this room.
sync.otherRoom: This device already belongs to another room. Joining the new one stops syncing with the old one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.persisted: The browser will not delete the data automatically.
settings.notPersisted: The browser may delete the data after a long time without use. Install the app on the home screen and make backups.
settings.privacyText: All data, including mentees' personal data, is stored only on your devices. The app has no data server.
settings.commentsText: Comments on this device are signed with the chosen person. It is a label, not an account: anyone with the room link can write as anyone.
